In the background, a vertical computer monitor mounted on a stand displays a colorful interface with numbers and grids, likely related to the game or a stream. (2) The shot cuts to a dramatic close-up of the man's face as he shouts a specific phrase with an exaggerated, intense expression. His mouth is wide open, and his eyes are narrowed behind his glasses. He wears multiple gold earrings along his left earlobe and helix. The studio lighting is bright and consistent with a studio or well-lit room, casting minimal shadows on his face. His face is meticulously made up with fake bruises, red abrasions on his forehead and cheek, and a small cut on his lip to simulate a post-fight appearance. He sits at a glass-topped mahjong table, looking down at the tiles with a somber, serious demeanor. She is also seated at the mahjong table across from the man, reaching out with her hand to pick up or move a tile. The room is dark with localized red and orange lighting creating a cinematic, moody atmosphere. (6) The man in the suit looks up from the table, staring directly ahead with a pained and determined expression. He delivers a line of dialogue with a furrowed brow. Artificial smoke or haze drifts through the air around him, enhancing the theatrical feel of the scene. (7) The video transitions back to the original bright indoor environment. The man, once again in his patterned shirt, delivers the same dramatic line of dialogue with a very serious, deadpan expression while looking directly into the camera lens before the video ends.
